summary: Hundreds of ready-made skills for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI and other agents, grouped by role from engineering to marketing and finance.

sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: This is a large library of agent skills (the README counts 434) for Claude Code and 12 other coding agents. Skills are grouped into bundles by role, such as engineering, advanced engineering, product, project management, marketing, C-level, regulated industries and finance. Each skill has a SKILL.md with instructions, and many include Python scripts and reference templates.
sixtySeconds.problem: Agents lack domain know-how like PRD writing, SOC 2 checks or month-end close. Installing a skill bundle gives them that structure without writing the prompts yourself.
whoFor: Engineers, PMs, marketers and founders using agents
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it for one install per role, with skills tested for whether they load on plain-language prompts and a built-in skill security auditor.
requirements: Claude Code, or another agent supported by the skills installer

overview: In Claude Code, add the marketplace and install a bundle for your role, for example engineering-skills. For Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot and others, use the open-source skills installer. You can also clone the repo and copy skill folders by hand.
Bundles include engineering-skills, engineering-advanced-skills, product-skills, pm-skills, marketing-skills, c-level-skills, ra-qm-skills and finance-skills.
The repo includes a Skill Security Auditor that scans any skill for injection, data exfiltration and similar risks before you install it. It is MIT licensed.
